name: Kokuren Uchuugun Shikan Gakkou Saotome Gakuen Nyuugaku Annai
original_name: 国連宇宙軍士官学校 早乙女学園 入学案内
source:
MILITARY ACADEMY OF U.N. SPACE FORCE is a special women-only academy where students are trained to control mecha. The reader can have a look at academy's facilities, participate in the everyday life of the students and have own simulation and perchance even real mecha battles.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/04/vn-of-year-1989.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
联合国宇宙军士官学校是一所特殊的女子学院，专门训练学生操纵机甲。读者可以参观学院设施、体验学生们的日常生活，亲自参加模拟战，甚至有机会投身真正的机甲战斗。

[引自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/04/vn-of-year-1989.html]vndbreview[/url]]
